h: An Undeceiving Spirit and the Transformation of Sin

p: In the holy Zohar at the beginning of this parsha:
אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
"Fortunate is the man to whom Hashem does not reckon iniquity,
and in whose spirit there is no deceit" (Tehillim 32:2).
This pasuk — its beginning is not its end,
and its end is not its beginning:
and Hashem does not reckon it to him,
while "and in whose spirit there is no deceit"
implies that there is no evil in him at all.
And it expounds on the matter of the Minchah and Shacharis prayers,
the attribute of night and the attribute of day,
When? When there is no deceit in his spirit."
that the five levels in a person,
nefesh, ruach, neshamah, chayah and yechidah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה סוֹף פָּרָשַׁת וָאֶתְחַנַּן)
(as written in Midrash Rabbah at the end of Parshas Va'eschanan, Devarim Rabbah 2:37),
correspond to the four letters of Havayah:
nefesh corresponds to the lower Hei,
neshamah corresponds to the upper Hei,
and the neshamah of the neshamah,
שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהֶם ב׳ מַדְרֵגוֹת חַיָּה יְחִידָה
which contains two levels, chayah and yechidah,
corresponds to the Yud and the tip of the Yud
and they correspond to the four worlds,
that the Kohanim and Levi'im radiate into Klal Yisrael
the fear of Heaven and the words of Torah,
so that the heart becomes straight,
and "for the upright of heart, joy" (Tehillim 97:11);
and when they merit the higher teshuvah
and willful sins become for him like merits (Yoma 86b).
That is, he merits the radiance of the maamar "Bereishis":
"Though your sins be like the years,"
these that are arranged and come
from the six days of Creation,
and as has been explained several times.
And it is like the Kohen Gadol radiating
from the holiness of the Kodesh HaKodashim,
And in the nefesh the greater part is evil,
is half good and half evil
And this is why the holy Zohar speaks
that is, he merits "the Fear of Yitzchak" (Bereishis 31:42),
fear of Heaven, to repair the nefesh.
כַּד אָתֵי צַפְרָא וִימִינָא אִתְּעַר וְכוּלֵּי
"when morning comes and the right awakens," etc.;
who includes also the attribute of Avraham Avinu:
יוֹמָם יְצַוֶּה ה׳ חַסְדּוֹ (תְּהִלִּים מב, ט)
to repair the ruach, which corresponds to the Vav.
And this is what it said:
אֵימָתַי לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
when does Hashem not reckon iniquity to him
that willful sins have become for him like merits
when? "When in his spirit" there is not,
that is, in the ruach, the Vav,
that it radiates from the Vav,
from the root, the letter Yud,
which is the filling of the Vav to the lower Hei,
and it is from the root, the upper Yud.
And then he merits to repair everything,
for he merits the fiftieth gate,
and willful sins become like merits.
But when there is deceit in his spirit,
even though he has the Yud and the Hei,
yet it does not radiate from the root
for he does not merit to repair
the half-evil that is in the ruach;
that willful sins become like merits.
שֶׁאַף שֶׁלְּפִי שָׁעָה מִתְגַּבֵּר עַל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע
For although for the moment he overcomes the yetzer hara,
grows strong and renews itself against him every day
and only when he merits, from the root,
then he merits the fiftieth gate,
and willful sins become for him like merits.
